'''Myocardial infarction''' was a condition in [[Human/Legends|Humans]] where the [[Heart/Legends|heart]] failed. It occurred when one's electrolytes count was out of balance, and a substantial amount of physical stress was induced.<ref name="invincible" />

In [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]], [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] [[Lon Shevu]] died from a myocardial infarction while being [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] by [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Tahiri Veila]].<ref name="invincible" />
